name: Meiwu Technology Company Limited

profile.description: Meiwu Technology is a Nasdaq-listed micro-cap in internet retail with a history of business model changes. TTM revenue is about $7.1M with a 10.1% gross margin and net loss of $18.6M; fiscal-year results reported April 17, 2026 showed EPS of -$0.82 [1]. Market cap is roughly $63M.

AI Deployment (0/2): None found. Market Share (0/2): Sub-scale player. Pipeline (0/2): None found. R&D (0/1): None disclosed.

ai_resilience.label: HIGH RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (3/9): Online retail intermediaries face real substitution risk from AI shopping agents and platform consolidation, and Meiwu has no defensive moat at $7.1M revenue and 10.1% gross margin [1]. AI Opportunity (0/1): No AI revenue found.

infinite_game.summary: Meiwu shows no evidence of an enduring cause; frequent model changes and heavy losses indicate a finite, survival-oriented posture.

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): No culture or tenure data available.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (1/2): The company has changed its business model repeatedly, though out of necessity rather than a guiding cause.

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (0/2): No evidence of costly principled decisions; losses of $18.6M against $7.1M revenue [1].

investment_thesis: Meiwu Technology at $2.38 has a roughly $63M market cap and TTM revenue of $7.1M, up sharply year on year, with almost no debt (D/E 0.08%) [1]. A small base and a speculative narrative drive trading spikes, and the company reported FY results in April 2026.
thesis_continued: The bear case is severe: net loss of $18.6M (-262% margin), operating margin of -124%, gross margin of only 10.1%, and ROE of -34%. Share price sits below the 50-day average, daily volume was a thin 26,160 recently, and disclosure is limited. Research coverage is sparse, so scoring leans on aggregator data and carries high uncertainty [1].
key_catalysts: Continued revenue ramp from a $7.1M base if the new business lines scale [1]
Debt-free balance sheet providing runway for strategic changes [1]
Speculative interest around strategic announcements, as seen in March 2026 [1]
key_risks: Net loss of $18.6M against revenue of $7.1M signals ongoing cash burn and dilution risk [1]
Very low liquidity, recent volume of 26,160 shares, and weak disclosure [1]
China-based operations carry regulatory and delisting risk
